thread.title: Warren Buffett ups stakes in Apple and Teva Pharma

title: Warren Buffett ups stakes in Apple and Teva Pharma
text:
Download PDF version 08:37 15 Feb 2018 BRK’s stake in Apple increased by 31.24mln shares, to 165mln shares, whereas it has also significantly reduced its stake in IBM. Apple and Teva's stock rose 
Famed value investor Warren Buffett has increased his holdings in Apple Inc (NYSE:AAPL) and generic drug maker Teva Pharmaceutical Industries (NYSE:TEVA) on Wednesday. 
Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway Inc ( NYSE:BRK ) confirmed the share buying via a Securities and Exchange Commission filing, which also revealed that the investment group has reduced its stake in IBM . 
As a herd of private investors tend to follow the so-called ‘Oracle of Omaha’ it is perhaps little surprise that both Apple and Teva stock was on the front foot ahead of Thursday’s open – the iPhone maker gained 1.26% and the latter was up around 8.5% in premarket dealing. 
BRK’s stake in Apple increased by 31.24mln shares, to 165mln shares, and it now holds 18.88mln shares in Teva. The IBM stake reduced substantially down to 2.05mln shares from 37mln shares. Top stories
